release_notes.headline_internal: Worker-bundle release provenance receipts now reach the release gate
highlights: Recorded worker-bundle provenance is now projected to the disk snapshot the archive evaluates, so worker_bundle_impact: required changes can complete release
worker_bundle_impact is projected alongside it, closing a latent trap where it survived only via its setter's direct disk write
Added signal-to-disk-to-gate round-trip coverage plus red-path guards; no test previously crossed that boundary, which is why the defect shipped
Known limitation: gate evidence authenticity is weak and is tracked in follow-up change bindProvenanceEvidence
